title: Bidirectional tunnel classification for the simplest bomb shape
statement:
A **bidirectional tunnel** is a tunnel whose motion occurs in two directly opposite directions. For the simplest bomb shape, only the wall hit by the particle is erased, and the particle starts with an initial angle of movement. **Bidirectional tunnel conjecture.** The only bidirectional tunnels are those corresponding to an initial angle of movement which is an integer multiple of 
$$
\frac{\pi}{4}.
$$
 The paper reports that no other examples were found in simulation, while related variants exhibit additional bidirectional tunnels.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1506.00683

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of June 2015).
